original_submission.content:
import os, sys, json, subprocess

BASE = "storage/shared/atlas/analysis/inquirer_veritas_power_law_sim"

SUMMARY_CANDS = [
    f"{BASE}/power_law_sim_summary_v4.5.4_avg.json",
    f"{BASE}/power_law_sim_summary_v4.5.3_avg.json",
    f"{BASE}/power_law_sim_summary_v4.5.2_avg.json",
    f"{BASE}/power_law_sim_summary_v4.5.1_avg.json",
    f"{BASE}/power_law_sim_summary_v4.5_avg.json",
]
PLOT_CANDS = [
    f"{BASE}/power_law_sim_v4.5.4_avg_plot.png",
    f"{BASE}/power_law_sim_v4.5.3_avg_plot.png",
    f"{BASE}/power_law_sim_v4.5.2_avg_plot.png",
    f"{BASE}/power_law_sim_v4.5.1_avg_plot.png",
    f"{BASE}/power_law_sim_v4.5_avg_plot.png",
]

def pick(paths):
    for p in paths:
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return p
    return None

def run_cmd(cmd):
    p = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if p.returncode != 0:
        print("STDOUT:", p.stdout)
        print("STDERR:", p.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
    s = p.stdout.strip()
    try:
        return json.loads(s)
    except Exception:
        return {"raw": s}

summary = pick(SUMMARY_CANDS)
plot = pick(PLOT_CANDS)

if not summary or not plot:
    print(json.dumps({"status":"pending","found":{"summary":bool(summary),"plot":bool(plot)},"expected":{"summary":SUMMARY_CANDS,"plot":PLOT_CANDS}}, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
    sys.exit(0)

cfg = {"env":{"python":"3.10","deps":[]}, "data":[], "outputs":[{"path":summary},{"path":plot}]}
with open("verify_config.json","w",encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(cfg,f,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)

pref = run_cmd([sys.executable,"storage/shared/agency_lab/repro_template/v2/preflight_static.py","--config","verify_config.json"])
hash_out = run_cmd([sys.executable,"storage/shared/agency_lab/repro_template/v2/hash_outputs.py","--config","verify_config.json","--out","verify_config.strict.json"])
ver = run_cmd([sys.executable,"storage/shared/agency_lab/repro_template/v2/verify.py","--mode","strict","--config","verify_config.strict.json"])

with open("verify_config.strict.json","r",encoding="utf-8") as f:
    strict_cfg = json.load(f)
shas = [{"path":o.get("path"),"sha256":o.get("sha256")} for o in strict_cfg.get("outputs",[])]

print(json.dumps({"status":"verified","picked":{"summary":summary,"plot":plot},"preflight":pref,"hash_outputs":hash_out,"verify_strict":ver,"sha256":shas}, indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
